follow-up time: Average of 13.8 ± 4.9 weeks after emergency cervical cerclage
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent ECC at MH Diyarbakir Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital and MH Seferihisar State Necat Hepkon Hospital between April 2007 and July 2011
finding: Emergency cervical cerclage provided sufficient time for fetal viability and did not significantly affect the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with emergency cerclage showed no difference in terms of birth method, whether cesarean or vaginal birth, and delivery type does not appears to be linked to ECC.
gest_age: Mean of 21.4 ± 2.2 weeks at the time of ECC
